statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let U := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/16:ℝ)⌋₊; let B₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/4:ℝ)⌋₊; let μ := fun d : ℕ => ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℝ); let c := fun (n a : ℕ) => ∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors a).filter (fun d => U n < d), μ d; let τ₁ := fun (n m : ℕ) => ∑ a ∈ (Nat.divisors m).filter (fun a => U n < a ∧ a ≤ B₁ n ∧ U n < m / a), c n a * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (m / a); ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), S n (τ₁ n) t * S n (τ₁ n) t * E (-(n:ℝ)*t) = ∑ a ∈ Finset.Icc (U n + 1) (B₁ n), ∑ b ∈ Finset.Icc (U n + 1) (B₁ n), c n a * c n b * ∑ r ∈ Finset.Icc (U n + 1) (n / a), ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc (U n + 1) (n / b), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt r * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt s * E ((((a*r:ℕ):ℝ)+((b*s:ℕ):ℝ)-(n:ℝ))*t)

plain_statement.zh: τ₁ 的平方相位展开为四重 Type-II 指数和。
plain_statement.en: Expand the squared phase of τ₁ into a quadruple Type-II exponential sum.

brief.zh: 把两个双线性展开相乘，合并指数相位；积分前先把父题写成对频率 ar+bs−n 的显式和。
brief.en: Multiply the two bilinear expansions and combine the exponential phases; this writes the parent integrand as an explicit sum over frequencies ar+bs−n before integration.
